text:
```yaml
name: Release binaries

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build and upload binaries
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Crystal
        uses: crystal-lang/setup-crystal@v1
        with:
          crystal: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: shards install

      - name: Set binary name
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = "Windows" ]; then
            echo "BINARY=noir.exe" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "EXT=.exe" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "BINARY=noir" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "EXT=" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Build binary
        run: crystal build src/noir.cr --release --progress --no-debug -o ${{ env.BINARY }}

      - name: Upload binary to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: ${{ env.BINARY }}
          asset_name: noir-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}${{ env.EXT }}
          tag: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          overwrite: true
```
